answer: Choose auditors by bonded coins, with replacement, rather than by account names. For an orchard report about a falcon, commit the report before three independent draws from fresh randomness; jurors compare it with customer-signed observations, so a fabricated fable can be exposed. Splitting one bond across clones adds no lottery weight. If an attacker owns fraction p of bonded coins, capturing all three draws has probability p^3; more influence requires buying and locking more coins.
